heading.title: Suits by or against trustees, executors and administrators

article.title: Husband of married executrix not to join.
article.content: Unless the Court directs otherwise, the husband of a married trustee, administratrix or executrix shall not as such be a party to a suit by or against her.
article.html:
3Husband of married executrix not to join.

Order 31, Rule 3

Unless the Court directs otherwise, the husband of a married trustee, administratrix or executrix shall not as such be a party to a suit by or against her.
